https://local12.com/news/local/woman-sen.text: GALLATIN COUNTY, Ky. (WKRC) - A woman was sentenced to 14 years in prison Friday for stabbing a man multiple times in Gallatin County last year. Michelle Anderson pleaded guilty in June in connection with the March 2025 stabbing at an apartment on Third Street in Warsaw. The victim was stabbed multiple times and flown to a hospital by medical helicopter. Anderson received her 14-year prison sentence Friday.
